title: myosotis traversii var. cinerascens
intro: Myosotis traversii var. cinerascens, commonly known as Alpine Forget-me-not, is a perennial plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Forget-me-not include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
